name: @solara/solaracore
description: The web engine for React Native macOS via Expo Modules: Chrome's own framework from our patched Chromium with our layer (engine/solaracore), hosting Chrome tabs in the app's views.

scripts.test: clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-zoom.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-zoom-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-zoom-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-throw.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-throw-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-throw-test" && node --test tests/page-calls.test.mjs
